title: CryoAtlas: A Large Curated Dataset and Unified Benchmark for Cryo-EM Atomic Model Building
abstract: arXiv:2610.41411v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep learning has accelerated automated atomic model building from cryo-EM maps, yet progress remains limited by the lack of large, high-quality datasets and standardized evaluation benchmarks. We address this gap by introducing CryoAtlas, a rigorously curated dataset and unified benchmark for density-guided atomic model building of protein chains. By integrating and filtering EMDB and PDB entries (up to March 2026), CryoAtlas provides 17,809 map-model-sequence entries, including a curated 16,657-entry training split. From this resource, we construct a 618-target benchmark with a shared evaluation protocol that jointly assesses structural accuracy, model-to-map fit, and stereochemical validity. Using this framework, we benchmark state-of-the-art learning-based methods against Phenix and AlphaFold3, comprehensively analyzing the impact of map resolution, sequence length, protein category and sequence identity on modeling accuracy. translated_title: CryoAtlas：用于冷冻电镜原子模型构建的大规模精选数据集与统一基准测试
translated_abstract: 深度学习加速了从冷冻电镜（cryo-EM）密度图自动构建原子模型的进程，但进展仍受限于缺乏大规模、高质量的数据集和标准化的评估基准。我们通过引入 CryoAtlas 来填补这一空白，这是一个经过严格筛选的数据集，同时也是面向蛋白质链密度引导原子模型构建的统一基准。通过整合并过滤 EMDB 和 PDB 数据库条目（截至2026年3月），CryoAtlas 提供了 17,809 个“密度图-模型-序列”条目，其中包括一个精心筛选的包含 16,657 个条目的训练集。基于该资源，我们构建了一个包含 618 个靶标的基准测试，并配有统一的评估协议，可联合评估结构准确性、模型与密度图的拟合度以及立体化学有效性。利用这一框架，我们将最先进的基于学习的方法与 Phenix 和 AlphaFold3 进行了基准对比，全面分析了密度图分辨率、序列长度、蛋白质类别和序列一致性对建模精度的影响。
tldr: CryoAtlas 是一个包含 17,809 个“密度图-模型-序列”条目的大型精选数据集，并配备了含 618 个靶标的统一基准和标准化评估协议，为冷冻电镜原子模型构建方法的开发与公平比较提供了系统性框架。
en_tdlr: CryoAtlas is a rigorously curated dataset of 17,809 map-model-sequence entries with a unified 618-target benchmark and shared evaluation protocol, providing a standardized framework for developing and fairly comparing cryo-EM atomic model building methods.
